Hello, this is SOLE Travels contacting you.

I would like to remind you that your tour is tomorrow. Your meeting point is at … on the upper level of Colosseo Metro Station, next to Café Roma.

To reach the meeting point: when you enter Colosseo Metro Station, before the ticket gates, you will see a passage on your left. Please take the stairs up, and once you exit the metro, you will see Café Roma on your right.

Have a nice trip in Rome!
